authority: Pass505 remains authority; Pass508 is I6E research only
decision_principles: Select persistent/recurring stock systems and their required compatibility surfaces for Profile 1.
Finite seasonal/anniversary/event occurrences remain preserved later profiles by default; historical design priority does not imply initial activation.
A selected family can remain research/provider-gated now, but RELEASE_SCOPE_CLOSURE must later transition it to accepted implementation or an explicit inactive disposition.
Protocol-incomplete paths are not assigned guessed MIDs; they are explicitly deferred.
Capability/UI models are not canonical-owner boundaries; retained typed ownership and cross-owner transaction laws remain controlling.

External payment-provider infrastructure is not fabricated for preservation; canonical Commerce settlement is selected and authenticated manual preservation entitlements use the frozen Pass424 settlement path.
Per-feature clocks remain typed; no universal 05:00/reset policy is introduced.

notable_profile_decisions.my_class: Preserved and routed to MentorStudentRelation but excluded from Profile 1 as user-approved low priority.
notable_profile_decisions.rune: Excluded from Profile 1 until active Rune protocol closure is recovered; no fabricated POWERUP_RUNE/SELL_RUNES IDs.
notable_profile_decisions.hero_rep_lock: Excluded until missing current numeric protocol bindings are recovered/dispositioned.
notable_profile_decisions.market: Excluded until undefined LOAD_MARKET request identity is reconciled; MARKET_BUY alone is insufficient.
notable_profile_decisions.guild_ecosystem: Profile 1 selects Guild core plus visible persistent Teams/Guild extensions (Campaign, War, rental, drink/tea, ranks, event log, publication).
notable_profile_decisions.study_dorm_villa: Profile 1 selects the persistent D06 Study/Workshop/Dorm/House/Villa/Library capability owners.
notable_profile_decisions.indiegogo: Profile 1 selected persistent social/shared-value capability with its own clock profile.
notable_profile_decisions.external_recharge: Canonical recharge/VIP settlement selected; unavailable external provider adapters may remain inactive. Manual preservation entitlement must be authenticated and must not masquerade as provider-verified evidence.
notable_profile_decisions.seasonal_events: Preserved in later occurrence profiles, not discarded.

authority_note: Promoted from Pass508 unsealed research after Pass509 I6E reconciliation; feature implementations remain individually lifecycle-gated.

invariants: Pass505 remains authority; Pass508 remains unsealed research.
Profile1 selects persistent/recurring systems; finite seasonal occurrences are preserved later profiles by default.
Every Profile1 selected/artifact capability maps to an acyclic graph anchor that reaches W2.
Later/deferred/inactive capabilities remain explicit in the whole-product capability ledger and cannot silently disappear.
No guessed numeric MID is introduced for unresolved protocol paths.
